h1: Shon Boutique Uthai Thani — a new English-garden boutique, quiet and pet-friendly
intro: If you want a stay in central Uthai Thani that feels new and clean, with a small garden to sit in and quiet surroundings for a good night's sleep — Shon Boutique is the name guests have started mentioning. It's a newly opened boutique hotel in Soi Nathong, Uthai Mai, styled as English garden meets minimal, with a garden, a lounging terrace, parking and a pet-friendly policy. Rooms come with air conditioning, smart TVs and strong hot water, there's a buffet breakfast, and prices start at about ฿900/night during promotions.

body.html: What sets Shon Boutique apart from the usual in-town Uthai Thani options is how new it feels and how it's styled. It's a low-rise building wrapped around a small English-garden-meets-minimal courtyard, with lounging corners and a terrace to catch the breeze. Several reviews note how clean and tidy the rooms look, helped by the fact that it has only recently opened. It's the kind of place meant for an actual rest in quiet surroundings, not just a bed to crash in.

The location is in Soi Nathong, Uthai Mai, near the Uthai Thani provincial court — central but tucked into a lane, so it stays quiet. It's only a few minutes' drive to the Uthai Thani morning market, the old Trok Rong Ya quarter and the Sao Hai riverside market on the Sakae Krang. Reviewers say it's easy to come and go for those driving in, and there's parking on-site — a point guests with their own car praise often.

There are several room types, from single and twin rooms up to family rooms for groups. Every room has air conditioning, a smart TV, a hairdryer and hot water, and guests praise the comfortable beds, cold AC and strong water pressure. The warm, minimal decor keeps the rooms easy on the eye and suits couples, families and solo travellers alike.
"Clean room, strong hot water, comfortable bed and good cold AC. The staff are kind and friendly, and it's quiet and private all around — well suited to anyone driving in. Great value for the price."

Breakfast is a small buffet with congee, salad and bread. Another thing many guests like is that pets are welcome — something you don't often find at in-town Uthai Thani stays. There's a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi throughout, and even a karaoke corner for groups of friends or families to enjoy.

To be straight with you, there are limits worth knowing before you book. Some reviews mention that the rooms are fairly compact with little storage, so a group with big luggage may find them tight. And because it's just opened, there aren't many reviews yet, so the long-term picture on upkeep is still to be seen. There's no full restaurant on-site beyond breakfast, so other meals mean heading into town — which is close and no hardship.

Overall, Shon Boutique scores around 8.5–8.7 out of 10 on the booking platforms from its first batch of guests — couples, families and business travellers alike rating it highly for cleanliness, comfort and value. It's no luxury property, but measured on its newness, the quiet garden setting, the clean rooms, the pet-friendly policy, the parking and a starting rate of around ฿900 — rising to about ฿1,300 at weekends — it's a well-judged pick for anyone wanting a clean, quiet stay in the centre.

A tip drawn from the reviews: if you're travelling as a group, ask for a family room when you book, since the standard rooms are on the compact side. If you're bringing a pet, message the hotel's page or call ahead to confirm. And because it's newly opened, it's worth asking about promotions before booking — at times rates start at ฿900 with breakfast included.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Shon Boutique Uthai Thani

faq.q: Where is Shon Boutique in Uthai Thani, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Shon Boutique is at 8/128 Soi Nathong, Uthai Sai Road, Uthai Mai, in central Uthai Thani, near the provincial court. It's tucked into a lane, so it stays quiet, and it's only a few minutes' drive to the Uthai Thani morning market, the Trok Rong Ya old quarter and the Sao Hai riverside market on the Sakae Krang.

faq.q: How much does Shon Boutique cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿900/night during promotions, breakfast included. Regular weekday (Sunday–Thursday) rates are around ฿1,000 and Friday–Saturday around ฿1,300. There are single, twin and family rooms — always compare a few platforms or message the hotel for promotions before booking.
Yes. The hotel welcomes pets, which is rare for an in-town Uthai Thani stay. It's best to message the hotel's page or call ahead to confirm the terms so they can prepare a suitable room for you.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Shon Boutique?
faq.a: Rooms have a fresh, minimal look, each with AC, a smart TV, a hairdryer and strong hot water. Guests praise the cleanliness, comfortable beds and cold AC. That said, the standard rooms are fairly compact with little storage — if you're in a group, ask for a family room.

faq.q: Does Shon Boutique have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes. The hotel has on-site parking and serves a buffet breakfast with congee, salad and bread. There's a 24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi, so it suits guests driving in. Meals other than breakfast mean heading into the nearby town.

faq.q: Who is Shon Boutique best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for anyone wanting a new, clean, quiet, garden stay in central Uthai Thani — couples, families, solo travellers or guests bringing a pet. It isn't about luxury, but it's well-judged for a restful night or two on a comfortable budget.
